ValidationRule.description: other reason used to describe why an account closed due to Low Quality - "Unable to Bind", "Low Quote Rate" or Lead Return Process Reason
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: ISBLANK( Other_Reason_Account_Closures__c ) && OR( ISPICKVAL( Client_Feedback__c , "Other") , ISPICKVAL( Unable_to_Bind__c , "Other"), ISPICKVAL( Unable_to_Quote__c , "Other"), ISPICKVAL( Issue_with_Return_Process__c , "Other") ) && Datevalue(CreatedDate) > DATE(2017,04,01)
